race.comment: AZARAX (2) kicked off this prep with a couple of decent efforts at BM72 level then took on a BM78 at Randwick a couple of Saturdays ago and did a fair job to finish midfield. Faces an easier assignment now and is cherry ripe. ALADDIN'S GIRL (6) was there to strike on the bend but couldn't quicken under 59kgs over this course and distance last Wednesday. Drops a huge 6.5kgs after Grima's claim and draws in a lot closer so it might be a different story this week. PAPPA BLUE (3) was five weeks between runs when a slashing second in better company over this track and trip last time out. Progressive four-year-old ready to peak at the fourth run back. KOIBITO (4) led all the way to salute at a short quote over 1400m at Hawkesbury recently. Tougher race today but if she dictates could be hard to catch. The query runner is ACCIDENTAL BID (1) back as a gelding after a 172-day lay-off. Went around at single-figure odds in a Group 3 and the Derby in Qld before spelling. Big market watch.
